fields.value: 3D Bridge Information Model & UAV captured bridge images in Eugene, OR

dsDescriptionValue.value:
UAV Data Collection Dates: December-1-2017; December-7-2017; May 11, 2018

This data will remain relevant for 4 years, it includes bridge condition data and its 3D model (structural). Bridge condition will change rapidly so those images showing cracks and spalling on the bridge will no longer be relevant.
